roadmap.title: First playthrough: collectibles and the Abandoned ending
roadmap.description: Play through once on Story Mode, collecting every document, postcard, phone number, signal and container while killing every enemy as Simon. Skip manual saves for Reject The Help, and finish the counters for gauze, radios, bottles and Widows as you go.

roadmap.title: New Game+ playthrough: Justice ending and speed
roadmap.description: Start New Game+, pick up the Axe, recollect every Clue and Document, finish in under 4 hours, make the two manual saves, and set up the Dog and Sci-fi endings. Do the brick, flare and bottle trick shots here.

roadmap.title: Reload saves for the remaining endings
roadmap.description: Reload your manual saves to finish the Sci-fi, Dog and Forever endings.

roadmap.title: Pick up the Pistol-3000
roadmap.description: Start another New Game+ and take the Pistol-3000 from the hidden storage area at the start of the game.

achievements.description: Escape the Otherworld and return to the town square.
achievements.summary: Leave the Otherworld for the first time and return to the town square.

steps.text: Play Chapter 2 (Escape) as Simon and leave the Otherworld.

achievements.description: Show Zoe you understand at the Shorefront Family Clinic.
achievements.summary: Finish the scale puzzle at the Shorefront Family Clinic as Simon.

steps.text: In Chapter 4 (Searching for Zoe), solve the scale puzzle in the @loc{Shorefront Family Clinic}.

achievements.description: Report to Dr. Glenn at the Medical Centre.
achievements.summary: Enter the Medical Centre as Zoe.

steps.text: Play Chapter 5 (Zoe: Rounds) until you enter the @loc{Medical Centre}.

achievements.summary: Solve every puzzle inside the Medical Center while playing Zoe.

steps.text: Finish every puzzle in Chapter 7 (Zoe: The Patient).

achievements.description: Accept the transfusion in the Alternate Medical Centre.
achievements.summary: Finish the final transfusion puzzle in the Alternate Medical Center as Simon.

steps.text: Play Chapter 8 (Many Into One) and solve the last transfusion puzzle.

achievements.description: Unlock the path to CEG Tower.
achievements.summary: Unlock the entrance gate to CEG Tower while playing Simon.

steps.text: In Chapter 10 (Missing Parts), find the 3 mechanical parts, build the @item{Constructed Mechanical Device}, and use it on the CEG Tower gate.

achievements.description: Make it back to the office on the 10th Floor.
achievements.summary: Get the CEO Access Card as Richard and return to the 10th-floor office.

steps.text: Play Chapter 13 (Richard: Another Attempt) until you pick up the @item{CEO Access Card}.

achievements.description: Exhaust the options in the Alternate Facility.
achievements.summary: Finish the final puzzle in the Alternate Facility (SWDP – Different) as Simon.

steps.text: Play Chapter 15 (Trying Again) and solve the last puzzle in @loc{SWDP – Different}.

achievements.summary: Defeat the Weight, the final boss.

steps.text: Beat the Weight in Chapter 16 (Eraser) as Simon.

achievements.summary: Complete New Game Plus on any difficulty.

steps.text: After you finish the game once, choose New Game Plus in the main menu.
Play through to any ending.

achievements.summary: Reach the Justice ending.

guide.context: Your final score picks the ending. Each Clue or Document adds 1. Each enemy Simon kills takes away 2. Each IV Bag revive takes away 4. Each Zoe mistake in the Chapter 7 puzzles takes away 3. Kills as Zoe or Richard do not count. Aim for 21 or more. The score is not shown in the game.

steps.text: Collect every Clue and Document. Each one adds 1 point.
Kill as few enemies as you can as Simon. Run past most of them. If an enemy follows you indoors, lock a door behind you and it gives up.
In Chapter 7, save before the surgery puzzles as Zoe and reload after any mistake.
Do not use an IV Bag to revive.
Before the Clamp Release puzzle in Chapter 15, make a manual save. You need it for the Forever ending.
In the last section, shoot the large enemy that cannot be killed with the @item{Flare Gun}. It freezes, so you can run past it.
In the final boss fight, stun it with a flare, step in, fire two @item{Shotgun} shots and back off. Circle the arena to find more flares.

achievements.summary: Reach the Forever ending.

guide.context: The score must land between 1 and 19, and the game does not show it. Use manual saves so you can try again. Kills as Zoe and Richard do not change the score.

steps.text: In a New Game Plus run, collect every Clue and Document and make a manual save just before the Clamp Release puzzle in Chapter 15.
Finish the game once. You will probably get the Justice ending.
Reload that save and lower your score. Take down more enemies in the last section and during the boss fight. You can also die and revive with an IV Bag, which costs 4 points each.
If you get the Abandoned ending, reload again. Pick up a few Clues or Documents in the last area and leave the enemies alone during the final boss.

If this keeps failing, reload your Chapter 10 save made after building the @item{Constructed Mechanical Device}. Kill about 10 enemies in Clara Woods and save again. Then skip documents and kill enemies as Simon until Chapter 15.

achievements.summary: Reach the Abandoned ending.

guide.context: Your score ends below zero when kills outweigh Clues and Documents. Each kill as Simon takes away 2 points. Each Clue or Document adds 1.

steps.text: Play on Story Mode and kill every enemy you meet as Simon. Hit downed enemies in Clara Woods with a melee weapon without walking into them. Being grabbed also counts as a kill.
You can still collect every Clue and Document in the same run. The kill penalty is larger.

achievements.summary: Reach the Dog ending in New Game Plus.

guide.context: This ending only works in New Game Plus, and all three coins must go in during one run. If you miss a coin, reload an earlier manual save or start another New Game Plus.

steps.text: Chapter 1: in @loc{Shorefront District – South}, follow the road to its end and enter the Video Star store. Take the @item{Bronze Coin} from the shelf in the small back room.
Put the Bronze Coin in the Guide Dogs for the Blind bank on Main Street, just before the Pharmacy.
Chapter 9: in Clara Woods, head up the street to the crossroads, then take the right turn into a backyard. Take the @item{Silver Coin} from the shelf.
Chapter 10: once you own the bolt cutters, enter the laundromat through the door at the rear of the Post Service building. Put the Silver Coin in the dog bank.
Chapter 15: when you unlock the door to the valve panel, also unlock door 793. Take the @item{Gold Coin} from the console in that lower room.
Once the container has been dropped, continue along the path to the red-lit crossroads of four corridors. Walk to the far end of the hallway and put the Gold Coin in the dog bank.
Defeat the final boss. The Dog ending then plays as you approach Richard on the pier.

achievements.summary: Reach the Sci-fi ending in New Game Plus.

guide.context: This ending only works in New Game Plus, and you must read all three books in one run. If you miss one, reload an earlier manual save or start another New Game Plus.

steps.text: Chapter 3: inside Zoe’s House, enter the bedroom. The book "History of Space Flight, 1952 – 1992" lies on the floor beside the bed, on its left.

Chapter 6: after you take Richard’s gift box, go upstairs in the hotel to the door with symbol buttons. The symbol order is Bird, then Tree, then Planet, then Bird, then the three-legged triangle, then Satellite twice, then Fish, Rocket, Planet, Dog and Pillar. Numbering the buttons row by row from the top left, that means pressing 21, 17 and 9, then 21, 12, 24 and 24, then 5, 3, 9, 1 and 14. A mistake resets all buttons.
Take the @item{Strange Access Card} in the corner next to the elephant statue.
Chapter 10: after the call with Richard, enter the store at the southwest corner of Atlas Square. Read the book on the shelf in the left corner, "Freeze Me / Wake Me".
Chapter 15: when you unlock the door to the valve panel, also unlock door 621. In that room, inspect the interstellar-travel book "A Map of Nowhere Else" lying beside the Resource Container.

Later in Chapter 15, after the red hallways and just before the door to the cutscene in which Simon removes his IV, use the @item{Strange Access Card} on the keypad on the left. The ending plays after the next scene and the final boss is skipped.

achievements.description: Finish the game in under 4 hours.
achievements.summary: Beat the game with a play time below 4 hours.

guide.context: The timer stops in the pause menu but keeps running in other menus and cutscenes. Reloading inside the game does not rewind it, so quit to the main menu before you load a save.

steps.text: Turn on Game Options > Show Time Played to see the timer.
Skip every cutscene and follow only the story goals. A run with all Clues and Documents takes under 3 hours.

achievements.description: Call all the phone numbers found in St. Amelia.
achievements.summary: Call all 13 phone numbers found in St. Amelia.

guide.context: Call each number as the right character, in or after the chapter where you learn it. Sit through the entire conversation and the automatic hang-up, or the number may not be recorded in your Discovered Phone Numbers. Progress is saved across playthroughs. If a number does not register, call it again in New Game Plus.

collectibles.name: Emergency Services — 900
collectibles.method: Inspect the "Your Local Services" flyer beside the phone and dial 900 straight away.

collectibles.name: Operator — 010
collectibles.method: Call 010 from the same flyer.

collectibles.name: Save Yourself — 100
collectibles.method: Call 100 from the same flyer. This line is the manual save.

collectibles.name: Tourist Center — 496 0496
collectibles.method: Read the number at the bottom of the map, then call it from any phone.

collectibles.name: The Haldane Hotel — 496 0244
collectibles.method: The number is printed at the foot of the Hotel Reception Notice and other hotel papers. Dial it once you have left the hotel.

collectibles.name: Unknown — 496 0842
collectibles.method: Back in Town Square, call 946 to hear the number, then call 496 0842 during this chapter. If it does not count, repeat this in New Game Plus.

collectibles.name: St. Amelia District Council — 0163 296 0595
collectibles.method: The number is printed at the foot of the Water Warning. Dial it from the phone in Zoe’s house while playing Zoe.

collectibles.name: Zoe Ellis — 496 0103
collectibles.method: Examine the phone, then check the folder next to the answering machine for the number. Dial it from this house while playing Zoe.

collectibles.name: D. Glenn — 496 0556
collectibles.method: Inspect the Medical Security Note on the booth window and call the number. The story needs this call.

collectibles.name: Hospital Storage — 5353
collectibles.method: Dr. Glenn gives you this number. Call it from the phone in reception. The story needs this call.

collectibles.name: W H O Dial Back Service — 946
collectibles.location: Phone booth where the chapter starts
collectibles.method: Read the poster on the right of the phone booth and call 946.

collectibles.name: Unknown — 496 0112
collectibles.method: After you call the Dial Back Service, you get this number. Call it from the pay phone.

collectibles.name: CEG Lockers — 496 0993
collectibles.method: The number is printed in the upper left of the Locker Barcode clues. Dial it while still in the Clara Woods area.

achievements.summary: Collect half of the 85 Clues and Documents.

guide.context: Clues and Documents both count. Progress is saved across playthroughs.

steps.text: Pick up Clues and Documents as you play. The Thorough Inspection checklist lists every one.

achievements.summary: Collect all 85 Clues and Documents.

guide.context: Clues give puzzle hints, and Documents are optional reading. Both count. Progress is saved across playthroughs, and you cannot go back to earlier areas, so reload a save or use New Game Plus to get a missed one.

achievements.description: Tune into all signals on the CRTV.
achievements.summary: Tune into all 19 CRTV signals that show a video.

guide.context: Turn the CRTV to the channel and press X when the tracking dot is inside the box. At a radio, interact with it, stop the colours moving by tilting the CRTV with the right stick, then fit the colours into all boxes with the D-pad. Channels that only track enemies do not count. Progress is saved across playthroughs.

achievements.summary: Pick up the Pistol-3000.

guide.context: The Pistol-3000 only appears in a New Game Plus run that starts after you have reached the Sci-fi ending once.

steps.text: Reach the Sci-fi ending once, then start a new New Game Plus run.

As Simon, walk toward St. Amelia from the start, beyond the houses lined with "For Sale" signs. Open the white gate and enter the storage yard. Take the @item{Pistol-3000} from the table inside the second unit along the right side.
As Richard, take it from the table in the Boardroom, next to the Level 3/4 Access Card.

achievements.summary: Pick up the Axe.

guide.context: The Axe only appears in New Game Plus.

steps.text: Finish the game once, then start New Game Plus.

As Simon, walk toward St. Amelia from the start, beyond the houses lined with "For Sale" signs. Open the white gate and enter the storage yard. Take the @item{Axe} from the table in the second-to-last unit on the right.
As Zoe in Chapter 5, take it from beside the shed in the first yard before Mr. Stewart’s house.

achievements.description: Create 20 new items by combining others.
achievements.summary: Create 20 items by combining other items.

guide.context: Progress is saved across playthroughs. Items you must assemble for the story also count.

steps.text: Combine @item{Gauze} and @item{Alcohol} to make @item{Sterilized Gauze}. Alcohol is common after the first Zoe chapter.

As Simon, fill an @item{Empty IV Bag} with @item{IV Fluid} by combining them to get a @item{Filled IV Bag}. Later in the game you find @item{Antibiotics}; add them to a Filled IV Bag to make an @item{Enhanced IV Bag}.

achievements.description: Kill with a range of weapons.
achievements.summary: In one playthrough, use each of seven weapons for at least one kill: Brick, Bottle, Flare Gun, Shotgun, Pistol, Pipe and Plank.

guide.context: All seven kills must happen in the same playthrough, before you defeat the final boss. New Game Plus weapons do not count.

steps.text: Kill an enemy with the @item{Plank} and another with the @item{Pipe}. Simon finds both throughout the game.
Kill an enemy with the @item{Pistol}. Simon gets it first, and Richard also uses it.
Kill an enemy with the @item{Shotgun}. Richard uses it first, and Simon can use it in the final section.
Kill an enemy with the @item{Flare Gun} as Simon. You get it in Chapter 10. The Pinpoint Inaccuracy method also gets this kill.
Kill an enemy with a thrown @item{Bottle} and another with a thrown @item{Brick}. Wound the enemy first, or use the Long-Range Masonry setup in Clara Woods.

achievements.summary: Land a thrown brick on an enemy’s head from over 15 meters.

guide.context: The throw drifts, so expect several tries. If you are going for Reject The Help, try this in New Game Plus.

steps.text: In Chapter 10 (Missing Parts), after the call with Richard, take the brick near the phone booth, just past the downed enemy. Do not wake that enemy: it is your target.
Make a save at that phone booth.
Walk down the street a little beyond Atlas Computers. Stop level with the wall that follows the line of shopping carts, lined up with the tile row that points at the enemy.
Point at the awning’s light and throw. If it misses, reload and shift your aim a little.

achievements.summary: Land a Flare Gun shot on an enemy’s head from over 10 meters.

guide.context: A flare flies straight for a short distance and then curves sideways, so a still target is best. If the enemy dies but nothing unlocks, reload and try again. If you are going for Reject The Help, try this in New Game Plus.

steps.text: In Chapter 10, the first time you enter the CEG Locker building, you receive the @item{Flare Gun} and also the South Brae key.
Make a save using the phone inside that building.
Go out to the playground and look up. A corpse enemy hangs from the light.
Stand beside the playground structure and shoot its head. If you miss, use the second flare or reload.

achievements.description: Kill many of one enemy type.
achievements.summary: Kill 30 Widows in total.

guide.context: Widows only appear in Richard’s chapters. Kills add up across playthroughs. Fewer than 30 usually appear in one run, so finish the count in New Game Plus.

steps.text: Kill every Widow you can in CEG Tower while playing as Richard in Part 5.

achievements.summary: Toss a bottle upward and hit it with a Pistol shot while it is still airborne.

guide.context: You can do this anywhere outside as Simon once you have the Pistol. If you are going for Reject The Help, do it in New Game Plus.

steps.text: As Simon, after you have the Pistol and the town has changed to the Otherworld, go to the @loc{Pharmacy}. Just beyond the gate next to it, a bottle lies on the left side of the path; pick it up.
Return inside the Pharmacy and save manually.
Outside, stand clear of anything overhead, aim straight up and throw the bottle.
The bottle lands a little in front of you. Walk forward, switch to the Pistol and shoot it before it lands. If you miss, reload.

achievements.summary: Remain hidden in a single hiding place for a full 60 seconds.

steps.text: As Simon, once enemies appear, step into a hiding spot such as a closet or a door outside a building. Stay there for 60 seconds.

achievements.summary: Use radios to distract enemies 10 times in total.

guide.context: The count adds up across playthroughs.

steps.text: From Chapter 5 on, turn on a radio you find. Enemies walk to it, and it shuts off by itself. Each time enemies are drawn to it counts.

achievements.summary: Throw bottles to distract enemies 20 times in total.

guide.context: The count adds up across playthroughs.

steps.text: From Chapter 5 on, pick up bottles and throw one away from you to draw enemies to where it lands.

achievements.description: Distract an enemy with a car alarm.
achievements.summary: Set off a car alarm to distract an enemy.

steps.text: Hit a car with a melee weapon, or throw a bottle or brick at it. Cars have alarms but vans do not. Enemies run to the car.

achievements.description: Finish the game without manual saves.
achievements.summary: After meeting Richard, finish the game without saving at a phone.

guide.context: Autosaves still happen as you complete goals, so you can play normally. Do not do the trick shots for Pull!, Long-Range Masonry and Pinpoint Inaccuracy in this run.

steps.text: When the game asks you to call 100 to save, back out of the save menu.
Never call 100 again for the rest of the playthrough.

achievements.summary: Open all 7 Resource Containers.

guide.context: Each container needs its own Lockbox Key, found in the same area. You need all 7 keys. Containers only appear as Simon. Progress is saved across playthroughs.

collectibles.name: Resource Container 1
collectibles.method: The Lockbox Key is in a kitchen drawer in @loc{Jess’s House}. The blue lockbox it opens is in the living room.

collectibles.name: Resource Container 2
collectibles.method: Climb out onto the scaffolding and re-enter through the second apartment. In apartment 1/1 on the second floor, the key lies on a bed in the room with an enemy. The container sits on a table on the fourth-floor landing.

collectibles.name: Resource Container 3
collectibles.method: Take the Lockbox Key from the key cabinet in @loc{Ward W} room 11. Open the container on the floor of room 01.

collectibles.name: Resource Container 4
collectibles.location: Apartment building northeast of Atlas Square
collectibles.method: Take the Lockbox Key from the cash register in the Post Service store on Atlas Way. Open the container on the kitchen counter at the back of the ground floor.

collectibles.name: Resource Container 5
collectibles.method: The key lies on a washing machine in the laundromat at the end of the alley behind the Post Service store. On a table inside the back office you find the container.

collectibles.name: Resource Container 6
collectibles.method: Climb the south stairs from the main floor and enter the west room; the key lies on its counter. The container is in the control room, right of the panel.

collectibles.name: Resource Container 7
collectibles.method: Take the Lockbox Key from the counter in the northwest room on the lower floor. Open door 621 at the control panel and open the container on the table.

achievements.description: Do both Zoe chapters without healing.
achievements.summary: Play both Zoe chapters, "Rounds" (Chapter 5) and "The Patient" (Chapter 7), without consuming a healing item.

guide.context: Using any healing item in either chapter loses it for that run. Reload your autosave or try again in New Game Plus, where Zoe has the Axe.

steps.text: In Chapter 5, you have no melee weapon on a first playthrough. Sneak past enemies or run from them. On Story Mode they do little damage unless they grab you.
In Chapter 7, pick up the @item{Plank} in the Medical Center to deal with enemies.
